interface.signature: def isPossible(self, N: int, P: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of prerequisite pairs P must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= task < N for pair in prerequisites for task in pair)
preconditions.description: All tasks in the prerequisite pairs must be valid task indices between 0 and N-1.

postconditions.description: If it is possible to finish all tasks, the function returns True.
If it is not possible to finish all tasks due to circular dependencies, the function returns False.
